argv: MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.name = 'application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)' RETURN m.class, m.name, m.return_type
MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.name = 'computeSHA256Digest(_:)' RETURN m.class, m.parameter_types, m.return_type
MATCH (m:Method) WHERE m.name IN ['sqlite3_open16','mz_stream_read_uint16','WebPIsRGBMode'] RETURN m.name, m.parameter_types, m.return_type ORDER BY m.name
MATCH (f:Field) WHERE f.name IN ['bytes','size'] AND f.class = 'WebPData' RETURN f.class, f.name, f.type ORDER BY f.name
MATCH (r:ResourceValue) WHERE r.key = 'DATABASE_VIEW_OVERLAY_TITLE' AND r.profile = 'en' RETURN r.path, r.key, r.value, r.profile
MATCH (r:ResourceValue) WHERE r.path = 'org.whispersystems.signal/Info.plist' RETURN r.key, r.value ORDER BY r.key

MATCH (p:Parameter)-[a:DATAFLOW]->(v:LocalVariable)-[e:DATAFLOW]->(c:CallSite) WHERE c.caller_name = 'OWSLocalizedString(_:tableName:value:comment:)' AND a.kind='ASSIGN' AND e.kind='PARAMETER_PASS' RETURN p.index AS i, p.type AS type, p.method AS owner ORDER BY i
MATCH (c:CallSite)-[e:DATAFLOW]->(r:Return) WHERE c.caller_name='OWSLocalizedString(_:tableName:value:comment:)' AND e.kind='RETURN_VALUE' RETURN c.callee_name AS sourceCall, r.method AS owner
MATCH (c:CallSite)-[e:RESOURCE]->(v:ResourceValue) WHERE e.kind='LOOKUP' RETURN c.caller_name AS caller, c.callee_name AS callee, v.key AS key
MATCH (v:ResourceValue) WHERE v.key='DATABASE_VIEW_OVERLAY_TITLE' AND v.profile='en' RETURN v.path AS path, v.value AS value

MATCH (v:LocalVariable)-[e:DATAFLOW]->(c:CallSite) WHERE c.caller_name='OWSLocalizedString(_:tableName:value:comment:)' AND e.kind='PARAMETER_PASS' RETURN v.name AS argument, v.type AS type, c.callee_name AS callee, c.line AS line ORDER BY argument
